children: Burford Capital entered into an indenture to issue $300 million of 8.000% senior secured notes due 2029. The notes are guaranteed by Burford Capital, secured by a senior lien on substantially all Issuer assets, and pay interest semi-annually starting April 15, 2027. Net proceeds, together with cash on hand, will be used to redeem the Issuer’s 6.250% senior notes due 2028, improving the company’s debt maturity profile.
: Indenture for $300 million 8.000% senior secured notes due 2029
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee and collateral agent
: Refinance 2028 notes and enhance financial flexibility
